workouts.title: Squat Snatch
workouts.description:
Squat Snatch 
1x3 @ Add your Personal Record below
1x2 @ Add your Personal Record below
2x1 @ Add your Personal Record below
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
* These should NOT be touch-and-go sets. Reset at the ground between every rep.
- Work to have a very consistent set-up position from rep to rep.
- Even though these weights are relatively lighter than the previous three weeks, still focus to move every rep as intently as you would if they were heavier.

workouts.title: Halting Snatch Deadlift + Snatch Pull
workouts.description:
Halting Snatch Deadlift + Snatch Pull
3x2+2) @ Add your Personal Record below
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- If you have straps, feel free to use them for this work.
- On the halting snatch deadlifts, work to keep a full foot pressure throughout the entire rep. At all phases of this movement, you should feel your entire foot from the heels to toes pressing into the ground
evenly.
- Keep the feet flat for as long as possible until extension on the snatch pull.
- Going lighter this week intentionally.

workouts.title: Tempo Pause Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Squat
3x3 Add your Personal Record below @13X1 / RPE 6
Rest 2-3 Minutes Between Sets.
NOTES:
- "13X1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :03 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.
No Bench this week for deload.
